name: openclaw-wechat-native
description: OpenClaw channel plugin for personal WeChat on Linux, via a local agent-wechat daemon: text, images, files, voice notes, stickers, groups and owner access commands.

scripts.build: tsc --strict --allowJs --skipLibCheck --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target es2022 --rootDir src --outDir build src/host.ts src/plugin.ts
